id: \bCan you push that boulder onto the switch?
en: \bCan you push that boulder onto the switch?

id: \bOh! The boulder has been moved onto the switch!
en: \bOh!  The boulder has been moved onto the switch!
it: \bOh!  Il masso è stato spostato sull'interruttore!

id: \bOh. The boulder is not on the switch.
en: \bOh.  The boulder is not on the switch.

id: This ladder leads to a random dungeon.
en: This ladder leads to a random dungeon.
it: Questa scala porta a un dungeon casuale.

id: The levels of Pokémon within are based on the levels of Pokémon in the player's party. The relevant code is in the script section PokemonEncounterModifiers.
en: The levels of Pokémon within are based on the levels of Pokémon in the player's party.  The relevant code is in the script section PokemonEncounterModifiers.
it: I livelli dei Pokémon all'interno si basano sui livelli dei Pokémon nella squadra del giocatore.  Il codice relativo si trova nella sezione di script PokemonEncounterModifiers.

id: The positions of the boulders are checked by a Parallel Process event.
en: The positions of the boulders are checked by a Parallel Process event.
it: Le posizioni dei massi vengono controllate da un evento in Processo Parallelo.

id: The hole event must have its "Through" option set, to allow boulder events to be pushed onto it.
en: The hole event must have its "Through" option set, to allow boulder events to be pushed onto it.
it: L'evento della buca deve avere l'opzione "Through" attiva, per permettere di spingerci sopra gli eventi masso.
